title: route_hash over hop ADDRESSES (16B): Python tunnel_auth migration
description: Spec changed (5muj): 06-security.md §8.11 route_hash now hashes full 16-byte hop ADDRESSES, not 8-byte IIDs. python/src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py: compute_route_hash does '_iid(hop) for hop in route' -> sha256(join)[:16]; _iid returns value.packed[-8:] (low 64 bits — was the IID under the rejected profile, meaningless under AddrForKey). The egress check '_iid(route[-1]) != egress_iid' and the decap path compare addr[-8:] slices. Migrate: hash hop.packed (full 16 bytes); egress comparison against the full 16-byte address (or derive AddrForKey from the pinned egress pubkey). Callers: gateway.py DecapsulationRequest / decap route extraction. COORDINATE with the shared-vector child (tunnel_authorization.json regen). Discovered-from 5muj.
close_reason: Migrated Python tunnel_auth to route_hash over full 16-byte hop addresses (spec 5muj option a): _addr replaces _iid (strict 16B); compute_route_hash hashes hop.packed with loop detection over addresses; create_tunnel_authorization/route_installed/TunnelAuthorizationTable take egress_pubkey (32B) and bind egress via yggdrasil_address(pubkey) full-16B compare; payload egress_iid claim (8B) and COSE wire format unchanged. Tests: gateway 15/15, vectors+resource green except 5 xfail(non-strict) — 3 stale-corpus (regen is osjz) + 2 pre-existing lptm call-site-2 (commented on both beads). Full python suite: zero new failures vs stash baseline. Filed flaky-ordering bug for tests/coap/test_edhoc_responder.py. 3x codereview self-completed after 2 reviewer timeouts + 20-min wedged background attempt (API contention) — per fallback rule. No P0-P3 findings.
